description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to styling images, including responsive images (`img-fluid`) and retina support (`img-retina`). It defines reusable style snippets for image handling in a web project.

methods.name: img-fluid
methods.description: Mixin to make images responsive by setting max-width to 100% and height to auto.

methods.name: img-retina
methods.description: Mixin to set background images for retina displays with different resolutions, including media queries for high pixel density screens.
